experiments.action: Mine existing DreamLedger/MTG/opportunity inventory for already-observed buyer demand before creating new offers
For every viable cell, define a low-friction entry transaction and a higher-value adjacent transaction
Turn each real milestone into an approval-ready public story and visual asset
Reduce each offer page to buyer, outcome, price, proof, delivery and next action
Calculate human minutes, infrastructure cost, fulfillment cost and gross contribution for each cell
For each active cell identify the single blocker preventing the next external economic transition
Mine prior failed/abandoned opportunities for warm demand and reusable distribution surfaces
When a distribution format produces a meaningful signal, reproduce the same mechanism on two additional relevant channels
Maintain a truthful public milestone stream based on real evidence
For each cell search for an existing audience, marketplace, community, API, directory or workflow already carrying relevant intent
Clone only cells with verified external payment and fulfillment evidence
After a verified cell, test the same mechanism against adjacent buyers/problems before inventing new machinery
